t: Dash Cleaner formulation designed to clean, restore, and protect dashboards and internal surfaces. Ideal for professional valeters and car enthusiasts seeking to restore vehicle interiors. It effectively removes dust, dirt, grease, and fingerprints from plastic, vinyl, and other dashboard materials, to leave a clean, refreshed appearance for a well-maintained automotive environment.
b: Cleans, Restores & Protects Vehicle Interior Surfaces
Safe for Plastic, Vinyl & Dashboard Materials
